title: The Bellwether King
description: A crowned figure in a black and white patterned cloak and wide-brimmed hat stands in a dark arena holding a staff topped with a bell, beside a large black bull. The scene is enclosed by a wooden fence lined with glowing white bells, with ghostly bull spirits and sparks visible in the lower portion against a dark, dripping background.
prompt: A mysterious crowned figure wearing a wide-brimmed hat and black-and-white cow-patterned cloak stands in a dark bullfighting arena at night, holding a long staff with a bell. A large black bull stands beside him. The wooden fence surrounding them is covered in glowing white bells. Ghostly white bull spirits emerge from the bottom with sparks flying. Dark, dripping paint texture in the sky, surreal and ominous atmosphere, dramatic lighting.
